patch_notes:
🚀 NEW FEATURES & IMPROVEMENTS:
• Artistic Brush Engine: Added professional brush size control for overpaints. Use [ and ] keys to adjust thickness on the fly.
• Global Voice Expansion: Added 5 new AI TTS languages (Chinese, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, Korean) + full support for Traditional Chinese.
• Workflow Polish: Window panning is now bound to Alt + Drag, freeing up the Left Mouse Button for precise 'Select' and 'Draw' operations.
• Visual Monitor OSD: New On-Screen Display indicator when switching analysis monitors.

🛠️ PERFORMANCE & BUG FIXES:
• Microphone Engine Rewrite: Fixed a critical Windows API bug causing duplicated 'ghost' microphones and broken regional characters.
• Performance Leap: Drastically reduced startup time via Lazy Loading for heavy ML models (MediaPipe/Rembg).
• Stability: Fixed UI lockup when switching languages in real-time and improved background TTS thread management.
• Smart Session Restore: Fixed a bug where empty board sessions would prompt for a restore.
